title: Make Key Info Stand Out
description: To remember better: - Highlight differently: Use bold colors or symbols for key points. - Add uniqueness: Attach a quirky story or image to important details. - Group by importance: Separate standout items from general information. Example: If studying a list, underline or use bright markers on the most critical items.
